label: def:q-chebyshev-function
title: The $q$-Chebyshev function
html:
To track how defect weight accumulates by norm across the spectral fiber, one deforms the classical prime-counting apparatus. The q-Chebyshev function is the partial sum of the q-von Mangoldt function over the geometry:

\psi_q(X) = \sum_{\substack{\mathfrak{m} \in \mathrm{MaxSpec}(\mathcal{O}_q(\mathcal{B})) \\ N(\mathfrak{m}) \le X}} \Lambda_q(\mathfrak{m}).

This q-deformed prime counting function accumulates the weights of fundamental defects ordered by norm. The function \psi_q(X) encodes the distribution of matter across the spectral fiber, weighted by the quantum Planck constant. In the classical limit q \to 1, this recovers the classical Chebyshev function \psi(X).
